name: chain
description: A two-step chain on a fresh model: three code-less assumptions and a code-less goal. Claude creates the vocabulary, formalises the four cards, freezes, proves a named lemma (Tom is a mammal) and then the goal with a tactic proof, and finishes proved.
subject: Demo

steps.newString:
namespace Demo

/-- creatures -/
axiom Creature : Type
/-- there is at least one creature -/
axiom Creature.exists : Nonempty Creature
instance : Nonempty Creature := Creature.exists
/-- is a cat -/
axiom Cat : Creature → Prop
/-- is a mammal -/
axiom Mammal : Creature → Prop
/-- is an animal -/
axiom Animal : Creature → Prop
/-- Tom -/
noncomputable opaque tom : Creature

end Demo

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Every cat is a mammal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Every cat is a mammal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Every cat is a mammal -/
abbrev every_cat_is_a_mammal : Prop := ∀ x : Creature, Cat x → Mammal x
axiom every_cat_is_a_mammal.holds : every_cat_is_a_mammal

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Every mammal is an animal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Every mammal is an animal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Every mammal is an animal -/
abbrev every_mammal_is_an_animal : Prop := ∀ x : Creature, Mammal x → Animal x
axiom every_mammal_is_an_animal.holds : every_mammal_is_an_animal

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Tom is a cat
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Tom is a cat
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Tom is a cat -/
abbrev tom_is_a_cat : Prop := Cat tom
axiom tom_is_a_cat.holds : tom_is_a_cat

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Tom is an animal
premises: every-cat-is-a-mammal, every-mammal-is-an-animal, tom-is-a-cat
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Tom is an animal
premises: every-cat-is-a-mammal, every-mammal-is-an-animal, tom-is-a-cat
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Tom is an animal -/
abbrev tom_is_an_animal : Prop := Animal tom

abbrev tom_is_an_animal : Prop := Animal tom
theorem tom_is_a_mammal : Mammal tom :=
  every_cat_is_a_mammal.holds tom tom_is_a_cat.holds
theorem tom_is_an_animal.holds : tom_is_an_animal := by
  exact every_mammal_is_an_animal.holds tom tom_is_a_mammal

args.summary: Tom is a cat, so a mammal, so an animal.
